entries.note: The command was invoked. The wrapper reported success for all 10 payloads because each payload's exit status came from the LAST element of a pipeline (grep | head), not from helm. The INNER Helm process failed: the companion call call_60c171e0942a444ba7d5469a recorded rc=1 and a Go-template error for the same chart. A render was ATTEMPTED; no manifest was produced.

The canonical result records rc=1, a Go-template execution error, and a zero-byte stdout. The wrapper nevertheless reported success: true. The semantic verification FAILED and the failure text was omitted from the summarizer input by policy.
NEGATIVE CONTROL — the wrapper's success status must NOT certify a successful render. No evidence supports R1_RENDER_SUCCEEDED or R1_IMAGE_EXTRACTED; the canonical record contradicts them.
entries.correction: ACT-CLINEMM-ROUNDC-COMPACTION-FIDELITY-CORRECTION01 — the companion receipt `summary-input-reconstruction.json` marked `approved_fact_r1_helm_render_succeeded.in_canonical_history: true`, which contradicted this entry and the report. That false positive has been corrected to `false`, and the RENDER_ATTEMPTED marker is now separated from RENDER_SUCCEEDED and RENDER_FAILED. The wrapper status (SUCCESS_WRAPPER) and the render outcome (FAILED) are DISTINCT facts and must never be conflated.

entries.note: The canonical result carries a successful grep for 'mvn' in .gitlab-ci.yml and a successful grep for skipTests / maven.test.skip across .gitlab-ci.yml, Dockerfile.roz and the module poms, plus surefire plugin declarations in two module poms. The FACT was available to the model as a status but NOT as content: the '[result omitted]' marker replaced the finding text.

The canonical results establish that Maven is invoked in CI and that skip flags and surefire declarations are present, and that Docker builds use -DskipTests. They do NOT establish that the inspected CI executes Java tests: the evidence is about the presence of build invocations, not about a test-execution step. The distinction between test SOURCES, test CLASSES and helper classes was not established by the retained evidence.

The gap is NOT that the evidence was never gathered; it is that the summarizer-input projection deliberately omitted the result bodies, and the carried command classification was empty because every Round C command starts with 'cd <path> && '. Re-collection with the same command shape would reproduce the same omission.
